instruction: Review the committed change benchmark-base..HEAD without modifying or staging files. objects.clone(value) accepts only JSON values (null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, lists, and string-keyed dictionaries). Return an equal value with recursively independent mutable containers. Later mutation of an output list/dictionary must not change input; keys and scalar types are preserved. There are no custom objects or reference cycles. Report only actionable defects introduced by the candidate; do not report style preferences.
